name: dml
description: DML / TSDML / DML-Framework monorepo. DML is an independent markup language; TSDML compiles DML(+TS) to runtime calls via a Rust+napi native compiler; DML-Framework is the reactive UI framework built on TSDML.

scripts.clean: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' exec rimraf dist node_modules && rimraf node_modules
